f-7: Community School Coordinators embedded at six Charlottesville school sites: ELC, Trailblazer, Tall Oaks, Summit, CMS, and CHS. After-school tutoring four days a week, on-site food pantries, and the Walking Bus that gets 25–30 kids to and from Trailblazer every day.
f-61: We coach the child, support the parent, and connect the family to the "constellation of care" around them: housing, childcare, health, food. A single coordinator may touch all three programs for the same household in a single week. test
